def.label: Twin torpedo tubes
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the numbers the Rust table carried, unchanged (25 g, 12 km/s of change of speed, an 8 s reload). The magazine is the fit's. CC.8 retunes the space palette.

def.label: Dual-mode turret laser
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the numbers the Rust table carried, unchanged. Both modes share the one 1 s cycle the kernel had; Q-49-24 gives each mode its own, and CC.8 sets offence at the 5 s floor (Q-49-19) with the switch rules.

def.label: Short-reach heavy turret laser
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the customs corvette's first laser, which the Rust table wrote as the turret with 180 damage and a 160 km reach. Its own row, so no fit overrides a number.

def.label: Spinal gun
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the numbers the Rust table carried, unchanged. Point defence and lasers cannot stop its round; a hull that burns during the flight is not where it was fired at.

def.label: Low-velocity spinal gun
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the belt raider's, which the Rust table wrote as the spinal gun at 12 km/s. Its own row, so no fit overrides a number.

def.label: Point-defence rotary
def.note: Doc 49 unit CC.6: the numbers the Rust table carried, unchanged. Two bursts stop a torpedo, which leaves the tube at an integrity of 100. Automatic by D-35-8 (Q-49-10).
